entries.title: Your first workshop visit
entries.body: Welcome to the neighbourhood workshop. Book an introduction before using the shared tools. Your first visit includes a tour, a safety briefing and time to ask questions.

entries.title: Book a workshop session
entries.body: Choose a workshop session from the weekly timetable. Book a place at least one day ahead. Bring your membership card and arrive ten minutes before the session starts.

entries.title: Woodworking tools
entries.body: The workshop has hand saws, clamps and a supervised table saw. Complete the woodworking safety introduction before booking powered tools. Ask the supervisor before changing a blade.

entries.title: Sewing machines
entries.body: Use the workshop sewing machines to repair clothing or practise a new pattern. Bring suitable fabric and thread. A volunteer can help you wind the bobbin and adjust the stitch length.

entries.title: Access and quieter sessions
entries.body: The workshop entrance and main work tables have step-free access. Quieter sessions run on Tuesday mornings. Contact the team before your visit if you need a different table height or a support person.

entries.title: Find the workshop
entries.body: Find the workshop beside the community library. The nearest bus stop is Market Street. Bicycle parking is outside the main entrance, and the courtyard gate closes at eight in the evening.
